listing.title: Sufganiyot Season Shirt, Watercolor Hanukkah Tee, Menorah and Jelly Donut Chanukah Shirt, Jewish Holiday Gift, Dreidel Festival of Lights
listing.description: A lit gold menorah with nine blue candles glows over a plate of jam-filled sufganiyot dusted with powdered sugar, with two dreidels, chocolate gelt and olive sprigs, painted in layered watercolor under "Sufganiyot Season" in warm script and "jelly donuts by candlelight" below. Made for eight nights of candles, family dinners and anyone who saves the last jelly donut for themselves.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-10-02 (before any art): web searches '"sufganiyot season" trademark', 'SUFGANIYOT trademark registration clothing USPTO justia', '"sufganiyot season" OR "donut season" hanukkah shirt' and '"jelly donuts by candlelight"' found no SUFGANIYOT SEASON or JELLY DONUTS BY CANDLELIGHT registration, filing or apparel brand. 'Sufganiyot season' is used descriptively in news and food writing (Israeli bakeries, the Histadrut). Sufganiyot products seen use other wording (Sufganiyot Squad, Sufganiyot Monster, The Best Part About Hanukkah Sufganiyot). Kept out: 'Eight Nights of Light' (an Etsy sign uses it), 'Eight Little Lights' (contains LITTLE LIGHTS, a children's clothing brand), '8 Crazy Nights' (film title), 'Let's Get Lit', 'Oy to the World', and any brand, bakery or character. tmsearch.uspto.gov, Justia and uspto.report pages are blocked from our sessions, so the official database was not searched directly; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
